issues.detail: The Greek 'απεκριθη' (apekrithe) is a passive/middle construction meaning 'he was answered' or 'it was answered to him'. The Vietnamese 'trả lời' (tra loi) implies an active voice where Phê-tu is the one answering, which reverses the direction of the action in the text.

The Greek 'μετα του συμβουλιου' (meta tou symvuliou) implies 'after/following the council'. The Vietnamese 'bàn luận với hội đồng mình' (discussed with his council) changes the relationship from a chronological sequence to a collaborative action.
